headline: New financial marketing rules take effect 30 September! Loan intermediaries collectively 'disappear': 80% of companies suspend operations and go on holiday; loan brokers waiting to switch careers?
summary: New financial marketing rules take effect on 30 September, according to reports. Reports say about 80% of loan intermediary companies have suspended operations.
why: Loan intermediaries connect borrowers with lenders, and China's consumer credit market is regulated closely by authorities. New marketing rules directly change how these firms can operate.
